## 2026-11-15：S2原生页面来源登记与逐页存储隔离 v1

本步改进评估设施，不是新组件修复或生产repair放行。新v3为每页创建不同BrowserContext，记录实际run/origin/target/session/frame/executionContext，ready与重复截图后各保存一份原生target/frame响应；错误角色按登记与比较对绑定，不按“Vue/San”文字或全局日志区间猜。未知session、冲突URL、清理／捕获异常保持阻断。

两次合成控制各6页、15项检查成立：localStorage、sessionStorage、Cookie、IndexedDB、Cache Storage跨页不串用，同页刷新保留；来源误导文本不改变所有者，跨页本地请求在Fetch层拒绝。37项纯登记及16项记录核验共53项新测试；加旧反馈50、适配39、repair34、动态键12，共188项分别通过，非全仓库或旧273项campaign。前三suite保存完整日志，后两保留已观察摘要／结尾。

旧冻结VolumeControl／BatchRenamer／AnalyticsDashboard共5静态场景10页原生重放13项检查成立。10页HTML、截图SHA和业务观察与旧记录不变；前4场景仍仅视觉一致，Analytics的10条源诊断原生归Vue，San干净，但1326/1625高度差、7项矩形差保留；不算4/5组件迁移率或新修复成功。

失败记录不覆盖：首轮受限环境CDP断开／报告缺字段；最小探针保留GPU访问失败stderr和exit2147483651。正常本机权限可完成，未使用--no-sandbox。首次fetch反例先被CSP拦截，3项检查不成立；改图片请求触及Fetch层后，两次15/15。只清理本任务专用临时profile，不动用户浏览器资料；一次拒绝的只读进程检查和已清理端点ENOENT亦披露。

69个旧相关文件、3个人工配置、6个冻结输入及旧21payload封存不变，Notebook保留旧135单元与metadata；旧24/30及token不回填。模型0／新人工0／依赖安装0／commit0／push0；生产Prompt、规则、调度与组件产物不改，任意公开键及通知／异常边界不豁免。技能用于区分设施控制、组件观察与残余风险，不冒充人工验收或Notebook UI验证。

新schema3尚无封存反馈适配，旧browser_feedback_v1仍仅支持schema2；不能改字段强行接入。下一步先做原生来源的可信封存核验与反馈接口、拒绝篡改／过期输入，再冻结错误级别、状态／阈值与生产协议。五类存储控制不代表登录／预置状态／service worker或全部浏览器状态；不新增互操作或业务调用协议，不直接付费全量或独立测试。

报告：`data/experiments/analysis/browser_session_isolation_v1_20261115/REPORT.md`；说明：`docs/ir-design/browser-session-isolation-v1.md`。以下仅只读校验，不启动浏览器、模型或服务器。

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, re
root = next(p for p in [Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents] if (p/'migration_pipeline').is_dir() and (p/'notebooks').is_dir())
base = root/'data/experiments/analysis/browser_session_isolation_v1_20261115'
read = lambda p: json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def check_seal(folder, pin=None):
    seal = folder/'SHA256SUMS.txt'
    if pin: assert sha(seal) == pin
    for line in seal.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
        expected, relative = line.split('  ',1)
        target = (folder/relative).resolve()
        assert target.is_relative_to(folder.resolve()) and sha(target) == expected, relative
check_seal(base)
baseline = read(base/'baseline.json')
assert len(baseline['protected']) == 69 and len(baseline['manual']) == 3
for path, expected in {**baseline['protected'], **baseline['manual']}.items():
    assert sha(root/path) == expected, path
for item in baseline['selection']:
    for field in ['source','target']:
        assert sha(root/item[field]['path']) == item[field]['sha256']
prior = root/baseline['prior_seal']['path']
check_seal(prior.parent, baseline['prior_seal']['sha256'])
assert len(prior.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()) == 21
old = read(prior.parent/'baseline.json')['prior_seal']
check_seal((root/old['path']).parent, old['sha256'])
for folder in ['controls_final','controls_verified']:
    checks = read(base/folder/'calibration.json')
    assert checks['allPassed'] and len(checks['checks']) == 15 and all(checks['checks'].values())
    result = read(base/folder/'result.json')
    assert result['schemaVersion'] == 3 and not result['passed']
    assert len(result['nativeRegistry']['entries']) == 6
    for name in ['storage_source','storage_target']:
        proof = result['captures'][name]['componentEvidence']
        assert set(proof['initialEmpty']) == {'local','session','cookie','indexedDB','cache'}
        assert all(proof['initialEmpty'].values()) and all(proof['samePageReloadPersisted'].values())
assert not read(base/'controls_retry/calibration.json')['allPassed']
assert read(base/'controls/result.json')['status'] == 'blocked'
smoke = read(base/'context_smoke/result.json')
assert smoke['status'] == 'blocked' and smoke['browserProcess']['exitCode'] == 2147483651
assert "GPU process isn't usable" in smoke['browserProcess']['stderr']
r = read(base/'frozen_components/result.json')
checks = read(base/'frozen_components/replay_checks.json')
assert checks['allPassed'] and len(checks['checks']) == 13 and all(checks['checks'].values())
registry = r['nativeRegistry']
assert registry['complete'] and len(registry['entries']) == 10
assert len({e['contextId'] for e in registry['entries']}) == len({e['sessionId'] for e in registry['entries']}) == 10
for e in registry['entries']:
    assert e['identityVerified'] and e['contextDisposed'] and len(e['nativeObservations']) == 2
    assert e['url'] == registry['origin']+'/page/'+str(e['index'])
    for obs in e['nativeObservations']:
        assert obs['targetInfo']['targetId'] == e['targetId']
        assert obs['targetInfo']['browserContextId'] == e['contextId']
        assert obs['targetInfo']['url'] == obs['mainFrame']['url'] == e['url']
    assert r['captures'][e['page']]['htmlSha256'] == e['htmlSha256']
events = registry['events']
assert len(events) == 10 and all(e['owner']['page']=='analytics_default_vue' and e['attribution']=='native_session' for e in events)
assert r['captures']['analytics_default_san']['clean'] and all(p['passed'] for p in r['comparisons'][:4])
p = r['comparisons'][-1]
assert not p['passed'] and p['metrics'] is None and len(p['styleChanges']) == 7
assert p['dimensions'] == {'source':[1280,1326],'target':[1280,1625]}
assert not r['boundary']['productionIntegrated'] and r['boundary']['modelCalls'] == 0
tests = read(base/'tests.json')
assert tests['tests_run'] == 188 and tests['new_tests'] == 53 and tests['exit_code'] == 0
assert sorted(row['tests_run'] for row in tests['rows']) == [12,34,39,50,53]
for row in tests['rows']:
    output = row.get('output',row.get('output_excerpt',''))
    assert row['exit_code'] == 0 and re.search(r'\nOK\s*$',output)
    assert int(re.search(r'Ran (\d+) tests',output)[1]) == row['tests_run']
implementation = read(base/'implementation.json')
assert len(implementation['files']) == 6 and not implementation['production_rules_prompt_scheduler_changed']
for path,item in implementation['files'].items():
    assert sha(root/path) == item['sha256'] and (root/path).read_text(encoding='utf-8') == item['frozen_source']
audit = read(base/'audit.json')
assert audit['new_model_calls'] == 0 and not audit['production_auto_dispatch_enabled']
assert not audit['legacy_feedback_schema_adapter_updated'] and audit['dynamic_arbitrary_public_key_block_retained']
assert not audit['notification_or_exception_boundary_resolved']
assert audit['original_batch'] == {'configured':30,'passed':24,'failed':6,'execution_errors':0,'total_tokens':1821544}
nb = read(root/baseline['notebook']['path'])
stable = lambda v: hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
assert stable(nb['cells'][:135]) == baseline['notebook']['cells_sha256']
assert stable(nb['metadata']) == baseline['notebook']['metadata_sha256']
print({'targeted_tests':188,'storage_apis':5,'native_real_pages':10,'source_warnings_retained':10,'model_calls':0,'production_repair':False,'batch':'unchanged 24/30'})
